name: Ric Lee Aston
original_name: リック・リー・アストン
source:
A character that comes with weak ranged physical attacks that induces the poison debuff.  His primary role is to offer area buffs to the party through his songs.

Ricky, his nickname, is also a student of Agaresta Academy, class 2-A, together with Mari and Shinya.

He loved Rock Song, and tend to sing aloud with his Electric Guitar. However, due to the curse of his Binds, he unable to sing his own song, thus making he a little depressed.
translation:
A character that comes with weak ranged physical attacks that induces the poison debuff.  His primary role is to offer area buffs to the party through his songs.

Ricky, his nickname, is also a student of Agaresta Academy, class 2-A, together with Mari and Shinya.

He loved Rock Song, and tend to sing aloud with his Electric Guitar. However, due to the curse of his Binds, he unable to sing his own song, thus making he a little depressed.
